annotations.title: The genre a novel's own prose places it in (or an author's novels)

description: For 'what genre is X by its prose', 'which genre does X belong to', 'what genres did Y write in'. Genres recovered from the words alone across 345 pre-1929 novels: the cluster's name, size, span, distinctive words and held-out library label, the novels nearest in time in the same cluster, and when the genre's name caught on where a name clock exists. Pass a title, or an author for all their novels.
